Adding the 'taker flow' confirmation (bottom 30% buy share) to the high-volatility drop scenario (rule #110) ensures that the selling pressure is actually hitting the market, not just stalling, making the reversal more likely once the panic subsides.

wild.why: Exploits the 'Stablecoin Cliffhanger': when stablecoin supply drops significantly (money leaving the market) but price holds steady or moves down slightly, it indicates that the selling pressure is being absorbed by strong hands, often preceding a supply-constrained rally.

Bets on the 'Crowd FOMO Reversal': when the Fear & Greed index hits extreme greed (top 10%) and the crowd long/short ratio is extremely high (top 10%), retail is fully extended, and any small trigger can cause a cascade of shorts/profit-taking, leading to a sharp correction.

Utilizes the 'Cross-Coin Divergence': when a specific coin has a massive open interest change (top 10%) but its price is flat (middle 50%), it suggests that leverage is building up without a directional move, often leading to a violent breakout in the direction of the larger market cap coin (BTC).
